name: arc-band
note: 13 Arc Band (references/packaging/13_arc_band.png, concept 2026-11-12): a closed 140 mm cube (the size of Final Blender/Perhaps_Select_Box.blend) in deep midnight navy rib jacquard (designer photo) with softly rounded edges. On the front, four flat gold ribbons run from the four corners: each hugs the vertical edge for a while, then sweeps in and meets a centred gold nameplate from the side (the upper pair just above the plate's middle, the lower pair just below). The nameplate is a rounded gold bar with Perhaps. printed in dark serif. A gold band of the ribbon's section runs round the lid's top edge, and another round the base's bottom edge; the ribbons meet them at the top and bottom front corners (designer note 2026-11-12: the gold must join up). The lid is the top lid_height plus a shield-shaped front flap bounded by the two upper ribbons (designer note 2026-11-12: Perhaps lifts with the lid); it is hinged on the back edge of the seam and opens 100 deg onto a navy velvet-lined compartment. The lower ribbons and the bottom band stay on the base. A straight bar of the same section joins the two lower ribbons behind the plate, so the base's gold line is unbroken when the lid is open; the plate stands just off the cloth over it. Cloth UVs wrap continuously round the vertical edges (seam mid-back); 3 mm soft edges. Walls 3.3 mm, just under the ribbon inset, so the flap cut never notches the side walls. v012 (designer note): no gold borders; ribbons, top and bottom bands and the bridge are gone, the shield flap seam stays, the Perhaps. plate sits 0.05 mm off the cloth on the flap. v013 (designer concept references/packaging/13_arc_band_v013.png): no gold at all; the flap seam is one sweeping curve, high at the left front corner, lowest just left of centre, rising to the right edge; Perhaps. is blind-debossed 0.35 mm into the cloth on the flap; one tone-on-tone groove sweeps from the right edge down to the bottom on the base front.

materials.note: glTF-safe stand-ins for the GLB (the v011 deep navy rib jacquard colour and normal maps on the cloth); renders swap in config/presets/box_arc_band_v011_look.json.
